title: Asking Hunter-Gatherers Life's Toughest Questions
summary: A travel vlogger asks the leader of the Hadza hunter-gatherers in Tanzania some big life questions just before a baboon hunt. The short answers touch on meat, honey and what matters in life.
why: HN cites it as a glimpse of present-day hunter-gatherer life, for example on diet and teeth, though one commenter calls it flippant and sensationalist.

quote.text: They say the important things in life are to have meat from hunting and to have honey from the bees, and that’s it.
